summary_en: 720,000 shares (4.20% of ex-treasury outstanding), ¥200.0M maximum authorization. Open-market purchase via Tokyo Stock Exchange. Execution window: 2026/07/03–2026/08/31.
title_en: Notice regarding Determination of Matters relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Terilogy Holdings Corporation's board resolved on 2 July 2026 to authorize treasury-stock acquisition under the Companies Act Article 165(3) and Article 156. The program permits acquisition of up to 720,000 ordinary shares (4.20% of the 17,106,232 shares outstanding excluding treasury) for an aggregate consideration not exceeding ¥200.0 million. Purchases will be executed via open market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 2 July 3 and August 31, 2026. The stated rationale is to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency whilst enabling responsive capital allocation in response to changing operating conditions.
